original_test_intent: Verify every approved MLNX port is represented by MST and reaches the specified InfiniBand physical state under a controlled loopback fixture.
original_method: Create a serial/BDF/MST/netdev/IB-device/port map; isolate workloads and provide loopback cabling plus OOB recovery; preserve baseline; capture full MST status; apply vendor-approved loopback per port; record complete ibstat and optional mlxlink/ethtool state; restore links and compare each port to SPEC.
manual_activity: Network/IB owner maps every port, installs/validates the loopback fixture, isolates traffic and owns link recovery and final verdict.
required_inputs: Approved loopback cable/fixture and per-port sequence
Expected MST and ibstat physical states
Maintenance isolation and alternate OOB path
Compatible MST/ibstat plus optional mlxlink/ethtool tools
safety_requirements: Do not loop back production or unmapped ports
Stop on unexpected traffic, link, PCIe, thermal or recovery issue; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Capture baseline and execute allowlisted per-port loopback
engineer_actions: Adjudicate each port and own verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: First netdev/IB-device ethtool/mlxlink output does not perform or prove all-port loopback and ibstat; sshpass/head are rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run full `mst status -v`; for each explicitly mapped port apply the approved loopback fixture and capture complete `ibstat` plus optional full mlxlink/ethtool evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All MLNX ports, loopback, MST/ibstat physical state and 10-minute allocations are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Drive a declared per-port map and fixture sequence with before/during/after link-state evidence and mandatory restoration checks.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact topology, blast-radius isolation, stop rules and complete evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A first-device read-only query cannot replace loopback of every MLNX port.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Loopback may disrupt Ethernet/IB traffic or isolate management; physical cabling and topology require human confirmation.

project_override_considerations: Owner must define ports in scope, cable/fixture topology, expected logical and physical states, acceptable transient counters and whether mlxlink/ethtool supplements ibstat.
expected_evidence: Complete port topology and fixture record
Per-port loopback commands/actions and complete ibstat output
Optional full mlxlink/ethtool plus driver/firmware state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source loops back all MLNX ports and checks MST/ibstat physical state; DeepSeek substitutes a first-device read-only ethtool/mlxlink sample and omits the disruptive fixture.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks if port mapping, safe loopback fixture, isolation/OOB, expected states or restoration cannot be established.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row389 Wistron-Networking-00378-V003: provide every MLNX serial/BDF/MST/netdev/IB-device/port mapping, approved loopback fixture and per-port sequence, expected MST/ibstat states/counters, isolation/OOB/recovery and restoration rules, and any supplemental mlxlink/ethtool scope.

review_improvement: Restores all-port fixture coverage and makes each disruptive link transition attributable, observable and recoverable.
independent_technical_reasoning: MST inventory, IB physical state and Ethernet/IB driver data describe different layers. A single automatically selected device can look healthy while another mapped port or loopback path fails; therefore every physical port must be bound to its software identities and fixture result.
